perks.name: Nightmarish Power
perks.description: Final blows to a challenging combatant or higher-ranked target grant Unstable Essence. When you have Unstable Essence, you receive grenade and melee stat bonuses.
perks.exact:
Upon scoring an Elite+ Kill:
Grants Unstable Essence for 15 seconds.
Scoring additional Elite+ Kills refresh the buff duration.

Unstable Essence | +30 Melee Stat and +30 Grenade Stat.

perks.name: Nightmarish Resilience
perks.description: When you have Unstable Essence, rapid weapon damage or final blows heal you and begin health regeneration.
perks.exact:
While Unstable Essence is active:
Upon scoring a total of 8 weapon damage instances within 3 seconds of each, counted up to once every 0.45 seconds: 
Begins Critical Health Regeneration and restores 20 HP.
Incurs a 2 second cooldown upon triggering before hits count again. 
Perk takes AT LEAST 3.6 seconds to initially trigger, then 5.6 seconds for the next reactivation assuming nonstop damage.

archetype.name: Powerhouse
archetype.description:
Armor configured for Guardians that take the word "impossible" as a challenge.

Primary Stat: Weapons
Secondary Stat: Super

item.name: Time Dilation
item.description: Your decaying Armor Charge has a longer duration.
item.exact:
Armor Charges decay every 15 | 18 | 20 seconds.

By default, an Armor Charge stack is removed every 10 seconds if a Passive Mod is equipped.

item.name: Reaper
item.description: Shortly after using your class ability, your next weapon final blow spawns an Orb of Power.
item.exact:
On Class Ability Usage:
The next Weapon Kill within 10 seconds spawns an Orb of Power.

Orb of Power:
0.8% | 1.1% | 1.25% | 1.5% Super Energy.

Incurs a 10 | 5 | 1 second cooldown between Orbs.

item.name: Powerful Attraction
item.description: Automatically collects nearby Orbs of Power when you activate your class ability.
item.exact:
On Class Ability Usage:
Collects Orbs of Power within 12.5 | 18.5 metres.

Will also pick up Motes and Crests.
